naive_ai_benchmark.naive_pipeline_strategy: 1-hop target/pathway lookup on BUB1B / SAC (R-HSA-141424) in OpenTargets, ChEMBL, or standard LLM prompt
naive_ai_benchmark.naive_top_recommendation: Mps1/TTK, Aurora A/B, PLK1, or KIF11 mitotic inhibitors (alisertib, barasertib, ispinesib, volasertib, paclitaxel)
naive_ai_benchmark.executed_test_in_this_repo: PRISM 919-line aneuploidy sweep (Entry 151/154) + C. elegans / human CRISPR Screen-A phenocopy audit (Entry 098/141)
naive_ai_benchmark.observed_quantitative_outcome: 33/34 SAC/Aurora inhibitors have rho > 0 (less effective in high-aneuploidy lines, Wilcoxon p = 0.0096); KIF11/AURK inhibition causes lethal spindle collapse
naive_ai_benchmark.clinical_consequence_if_followed: CATASTROPHIC HARM (Do-Not K1): compounds constitutional mitotic checkpoint failure and accelerates chromosomal chaos
naive_ai_benchmark.iteration6_calibrated_resolution: hard-blocks all 34 SAC/Aurora/PLK1/KIF11 inhibitors (safety_factor = 0.0000); pivots to abundance rescue and senolysis

naive_ai_benchmark.naive_pipeline_strategy: standard oncology guideline lookup for HP:0002859 (embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma) without patient VCF or HPO cross-check
naive_ai_benchmark.naive_top_recommendation: standard-dose vincristine + dactinomycin + cyclophosphamide (VAC backbone) without PGx or neuromuscular gating
naive_ai_benchmark.executed_test_in_this_repo: 2-source per-child safety audit: PharmCAT VCF star-allele caller + OnSIDES boxed-label x 8 HPO matcher (Entry 152/161)
naive_ai_benchmark.observed_quantitative_outcome: vincristine is the ONLY drug flagged by BOTH independent safety sources: CYP3A5 *1/*3 genotype + HP:0003202 skeletal muscle atrophy label match
naive_ai_benchmark.clinical_consequence_if_followed: SEVERE NEURO/MYOTOXICITY (Flag K2): impaired CYP3A5 clearance + pre-existing muscle atrophy heightens vincristine peripheral neuropathy
naive_ai_benchmark.iteration6_calibrated_resolution: flags vincristine for mandatory oncology dose-intensity review; proposes SLCO1B1-gated simvastatin/lovastatin (NCT02390843) as non-neurotoxic D4 adjunct

naive_ai_benchmark.naive_pipeline_strategy: heuristic variant-type rule: stop_gained allele -> prescribe premature-stop readthrough agent (ataluren or gentamicin)
naive_ai_benchmark.naive_top_recommendation: ataluren (Translarna) or aminoglycoside readthrough (gentamicin) as primary monotherapy
naive_ai_benchmark.executed_test_in_this_repo: Route R1 stop-codon + +4 nucleotide sequence-context model + near-cognate tRNA fidelity gap + EVPPI (Entry 159/162)
naive_ai_benchmark.observed_quantitative_outcome: suboptimal stop context (R1_score = 0.33); net functional BubR1 increase is 0.075%-1.5% vs 8.5%-28.5% rescue gap; EVPPI(readthrough) = 0.0000
naive_ai_benchmark.clinical_consequence_if_followed: FUTILITY + OTO/NEPHROTOXICITY: fails to cross the Bub1b^{H/H} dosage threshold while exposing child to aminoglycoside toxicity (safety = 0.25)
naive_ai_benchmark.iteration6_calibrated_resolution: assigns zero VOI to readthrough reporter (EVSI = 0.0000); focuses 100% of wet-lab budget on the missense stability blot (EVSI = 69.1% of EVPI)

naive_ai_benchmark.naive_pipeline_strategy: uncontrolled transcriptomic signature reversal: query BUB1B-knockdown DEGs in LINCS L1000 and pick top cosine reverser
naive_ai_benchmark.naive_top_recommendation: top raw LINCS L1000 anti-correlating perturbanogens without proliferation-confounder or FDR filtering
naive_ai_benchmark.executed_test_in_this_repo: 12-hallmark E2F/G2M/MYC proliferation-confounder audit + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR gate across 3,849 compounds (Entry 153/162)
naive_ai_benchmark.observed_quantitative_outcome: 11/12 (91.7%) of BUB1B signature hallmarks are generic cell-cycle/proliferation modules (H097 confirmed); 0/3,849 drugs pass FDR < 0.05 (H091 refuted)
naive_ai_benchmark.clinical_consequence_if_followed: FALSE-POSITIVE ANTIPROLIFERATIVES: selects generic cytostatic toxins that arrest dividing tissues rather than rescuing BubR1 function
naive_ai_benchmark.iteration6_calibrated_resolution: retains negative result in repository; requires orthogonal generator convergence (twin|prism) or direct proteome abundance readout

naive_ai_benchmark.naive_pipeline_strategy: uncalibrated multi-omics aggregation: rank 1-replicate cell-line proteome hits equal to multi-animal in vivo survival studies
naive_ai_benchmark.naive_top_recommendation: gliclazide / migalastat (u = 0.7000) ranked above NMN (u = 0.4800) and niacin/nicotinamide (u = 0.1920) under w_R2 = 1.00
naive_ai_benchmark.executed_test_in_this_repo: 20-step Route-R2 weight sweep w_R2 in [0.05, 1.00] + asynchronous HCT116 positive-control check + pseudokinase pocket audit (Entry 163)
naive_ai_benchmark.observed_quantitative_outcome: asynchronous HCT116 screen misses mitotic taxane/veliparib control (H099 refuted) and variant is buried (RSA < 0.20); calibrating w_R2 = 0.25 flips leaders
naive_ai_benchmark.clinical_consequence_if_followed: EVIDENCE-HIERARCHY INVERSION: prioritizes an unverified 1-replicate HCT116 screen hit over Rung-3 in vivo Bub1b^{H/H} survival rescue
naive_ai_benchmark.iteration6_calibrated_resolution: calibrates w_R2 = 0.25 so NMN (overall) and niacin/nicotinamide (FDA-approved, 3 iterations) lead unstable branch while migalastat/gliclazide serve as backups

sensitivity.interpretation: Unweighted coverage of an explicitly specified Cartesian assumption grid; not probability, confidence, empirical assay validation or clinical benefit.

recommendation_definitions.recommendation_changed_from_canonical: Scenario pre-test expected-utility maximizing action differs from canonical pre-test NMN; not a state-branch comparison.
recommendation_definitions.assay_changes_recommendation: At least one positive-probability assay outcome selects a different action from that same scenario's pre-test maximizing action.

utility_rationale.route:R2: strong discount, hierarchy calibration, and no discount
utility_rationale.safety:unassessed: conservative, canonical, and no safety discount
utility_rationale.applicability:missense_inactive:missense: canonical zero, 0.25, and 0.50 cross-state benefit for inactive-branch drugs

sensitivity.fixed: Other canonical coefficients, independent state priors, max evidence combination and readthrough prior remain unchanged; R1=R3=1.
sensitivity.structural_caveats: Zero readthrough EVSI follows the fixed derived feasibility prior and action structure, not empirical proof of assay uselessness. EVPI=0.18 is invariant only on the original route-only sweep, not this joint grid.
